career.en: Young people should think carefully about their career before choosing a degree.
career.zh: 年轻人在选择学位前应该仔细考虑职业生涯。

occupation.en: People in this occupation often have to work long hours at night.
occupation.zh: 从事这种职业的人常常要夜间长时间工作。

profession.en: Teaching is a profession that requires both knowledge and patience.
profession.zh: 教学是一种既需要知识又需要耐心的职业。

professional.en: Professional training should be available to workers throughout their lives.
professional.zh: 工人应该终身都能接受专业培训。

professional.en: Health professionals have warned about the dangers of too much sugar.
professional.zh: 医疗专业人士警告过量摄入糖的危害。

employment.en: Automation could reduce employment in many traditional industries.
employment.zh: 自动化可能减少许多传统行业的就业。

job-market.en: Graduates need practical skills to compete in today's job market.
job-market.zh: 毕业生需要实用技能才能在当今的就业市场竞争。

job-security.en: Many young workers today have little job security or regular income.
job-security.zh: 如今许多年轻工人几乎没有工作保障或固定收入。

job-satisfaction.en: Job satisfaction is often more important than a high salary.
job-satisfaction.zh: 工作满意度往往比高薪更重要。

career-prospects.en: Learning a foreign language can greatly improve your career prospects.
career-prospects.zh: 学习外语能大大改善你的职业前景。

promotion-prospects.en: Women often have worse promotion prospects than men in the same jobs.
promotion-prospects.zh: 女性的晋升机会常常比同岗位的男性差。

white-collar.en: White-collar workers usually spend most of their day sitting at a desk.
white-collar.zh: 白领工人一天大部分时间通常都坐在办公桌前。

blue-collar.en: Blue-collar jobs in factories have declined in many developed countries.
blue-collar.zh: 在许多发达国家,工厂里的蓝领工作减少了。

manual-labour.en: Machines have replaced much of the manual labour once done in factories.
manual-labour.zh: 机器已经取代了工厂里过去的许多体力劳动。

skilled.en: There is a serious shortage of skilled workers in the building trade.
skilled.zh: 建筑行业严重缺乏熟练工人。

unskilled.en: Unskilled workers are the most likely to lose their jobs to machines.
unskilled.zh: 非熟练工人最有可能因机器而失业。

expertise.en: The company lacks the technical expertise to develop this new product.
expertise.zh: 这家公司缺乏开发这种新产品的专业知识。

workload.en: Teachers complain that their heavy workload leaves little time for their families.
workload.zh: 老师们抱怨繁重的工作量让他们几乎没有时间陪家人。

burnout.en: Long hours and constant pressure can lead to burnout among nurses.
burnout.zh: 长时间工作和持续的压力可能导致护士职业倦怠。

workaholic.en: A workaholic may damage both their health and their family life.
workaholic.zh: 工作狂可能既损害健康,也损害家庭生活。

remote-working.en: Remote working saves time and reduces traffic during the rush hour.
remote-working.zh: 远程办公节省时间,还能减少高峰期的交通流量。

freelance.en: Freelance work offers flexibility but no guarantee of a regular income.
freelance.zh: 自由职业提供灵活性,但不能保证有固定收入。

self-employed.en: Self-employed workers enjoy more freedom but often have less financial security.
self-employed.zh: 个体经营者享有更多自由,但经济保障往往较少。

gig-economy.en: Workers in the gig economy often have no sick pay or holiday pay.
gig-economy.zh: 零工经济中的工人常常没有病假工资或假期工资。

minimum-wage.en: Raising the minimum wage could help the lowest-paid workers in society.
minimum-wage.zh: 提高最低工资可以帮助社会上收入最低的工人。

earnings.en: Average earnings have not kept up with rising house prices.
earnings.zh: 平均收入没有跟上房价上涨的速度。

fringe-benefits.en: Fringe benefits, such as free meals, can help companies to attract staff.
fringe-benefits.zh: 免费餐食等附加福利能帮助公司吸引员工。

gender-gap.en: The gender gap in pay remains large in many industries.
gender-gap.zh: 在许多行业,薪酬方面的性别差距仍然很大。

gender-equality.en: Gender equality at work benefits both employers and the wider economy.
gender-equality.zh: 工作中的性别平等对雇主和整体经济都有益。

gender-discrimination.en: Gender discrimination remains a serious barrier to women's progress in some jobs.
gender-discrimination.zh: 在某些工作中,性别歧视仍是女性发展的严重障碍。

glass-ceiling.en: The glass ceiling still prevents many women from reaching top jobs.
glass-ceiling.zh: 玻璃天花板仍然阻碍许多女性获得高层职位。

feminism.en: Feminism has helped women to gain greater rights at home and at work.
feminism.zh: 女权主义帮助女性在家庭和工作中获得了更多权利。

equal-pay.en: Men and women should receive equal pay for doing the same job.
equal-pay.zh: 男女做同样的工作应该同工同酬。

paternity-leave.en: Longer paternity leave would allow fathers to spend more time with their babies.
paternity-leave.zh: 更长的陪产假能让父亲有更多时间陪伴婴儿。

lay-off.en: Falling sales forced the company to lay off a third of its workers.
lay-off.zh: 销量下滑迫使公司裁掉三分之一的员工。

redundancy.en: Workers facing redundancy need help to find new types of employment.
redundancy.zh: 面临裁员的工人需要帮助,以找到新类型的工作。

dismiss.en: Employers should not be able to dismiss workers without a good reason.
dismiss.zh: 雇主不应在没有充分理由的情况下解雇员工。

dismiss.en: It would be wrong to dismiss these concerns as unimportant.
dismiss.zh: 把这些担忧视为不重要是错误的。

unemployed.en: Unemployed young people should receive training to help them find work.
unemployed.zh: 失业的年轻人应该接受培训,帮助他们找到工作。

jobseeker.en: Each jobseeker should receive advice on how to write a good CV.
jobseeker.zh: 每位求职者都应该得到关于如何写好简历的建议。

labour-market.en: Older workers may find it hard to compete in the modern labour market.
labour-market.zh: 年长的工人可能很难在现代劳动力市场上竞争。

arduous.en: Mining remains an arduous and dangerous job in many parts of the world.
arduous.zh: 在世界许多地方,采矿仍是一项艰巨而危险的工作。

repetitive.en: Robots are well suited to repetitive tasks that humans find boring.
repetitive.zh: 机器人非常适合人类觉得无聊的重复性工作。

freelancer.en: A freelancer may have to work evenings and weekends to earn enough.
freelancer.zh: 自由职业者可能要在晚上和周末工作才能赚够钱。

programmer.en: A good programmer can find well-paid work almost anywhere in the world.
programmer.zh: 优秀的程序员几乎可以在世界任何地方找到高薪工作。

translator.en: Software may eventually replace the work of a human translator.
translator.zh: 软件最终可能取代人工译者的工作。

detective.en: The detective spent months collecting evidence against the company.
detective.zh: 这名侦探花了几个月时间收集对这家公司不利的证据。

chef.en: A chef often has to work long hours in hot and crowded conditions.
chef.zh: 厨师常常要在炎热拥挤的环境中长时间工作。

tailor.en: The number of people who train as a tailor has fallen sharply.
tailor.zh: 接受裁缝培训的人数急剧下降。

florist.en: A local florist may struggle to compete with cheap supermarket flowers.
florist.zh: 当地的花商可能很难与超市的廉价鲜花竞争。

butcher.en: The local butcher closed when a large supermarket opened nearby.
butcher.zh: 附近开了一家大超市后,当地的肉贩关了店。

greengrocer.en: Fewer people buy their vegetables from a greengrocer these days.
greengrocer.zh: 如今从蔬果商那里买菜的人越来越少了。

decorator.en: We hired a decorator to paint the walls of the new office.
decorator.zh: 我们雇了一名室内装修工来粉刷新办公室的墙。

novelist.en: A successful novelist may spend years writing a single book.
novelist.zh: 成功的小说家可能花费数年时间写一本书。

composer.en: The composer's music is still played regularly by orchestras around the world.
composer.zh: 这位作曲家的音乐至今仍被世界各地的管弦乐队经常演奏。

philosopher.en: The Greek philosopher argued that education should develop good citizens.
philosopher.zh: 这位希腊哲学家认为,教育应该培养好公民。

physicist.en: The young physicist won an international prize for her work on light.
physicist.zh: 这位年轻的物理学家因光学研究获得了一项国际奖项。

geologist.en: A geologist studies rocks to understand the history of the Earth.
geologist.zh: 地质学家研究岩石以了解地球的历史。

mathematician.en: Every mathematician knows how difficult this ancient problem has been.
mathematician.zh: 每位数学家都知道这个古老的问题有多难。

biologist.en: A marine biologist studies the plants and animals that live in the sea.
biologist.zh: 海洋生物学家研究生活在海中的动植物。

prestige.en: Many people choose medicine because of the prestige of the profession.
prestige.zh: 许多人选择学医是因为这个职业的声望。
